name: Rainbow Pairs
summary: Bracket and quote pairs in depth colors · jump to pair / sibling / parent / child
description: Colors every bracket/quote pair by nesting depth so pairs can be told apart at a glance, marks unmatched ones, underlines the pair around the caret, and adds navigation: matching pair (Ctrl+M), previous/next sibling (Ctrl+Alt+, / .), parent (Ctrl+Alt+[), first child (Ctrl+Alt+]), plus an 'Bracket Navigation' submenu in the editor context menu. Built into the app (kind = builtin): installing turns it on and adds its settings group, removing turns it off and hides them; settings live under rainbowpair.*.
author: SosomLab

messages.install: Rainbow Pairs is on. Settings: Preferences ▸ Editor ▸ rainbowpair.* · Esc/Ctrl+M to jump between pairs.
